name: micro_vec
description: Microbenchmarks: vsetvli cost, vadd/vle8/vse8 versus VL (1..512), e64 vadd/vmul/vfadd/vredsum (cycles per vector instruction)
expect: MICRO CHECK OK micro_vec iterations={iterations} regions=31
units: vector instructions per region (cycles/iter = cycles per vector instruction)

region_ops.1: region overhead: call + return of an empty kernel (cycles/iter is not per-op)
region_ops.2: vsetvli e8 m8 with the same AVL and vtype as the previous one
region_ops.3: vsetvli alternating e8/m8 and e32/m1 (vtype changes every time)
region_ops.4: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=1, dependent through vd
region_ops.5: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=2, dependent through vd
region_ops.6: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=4, dependent through vd
region_ops.7: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=8, dependent through vd
region_ops.8: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=16, dependent through vd
region_ops.9: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=32, dependent through vd
region_ops.10: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=64, dependent through vd
region_ops.11: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=128, dependent through vd
region_ops.12: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=256, dependent through vd
region_ops.13: vadd.vv e8 m8, vl=512, dependent through vd
region_ops.31: vredsum.vs e64 m1, vl=8, dependent through vs1/vd
